messages:
Maya (Support): FYI customer request from Acme Financial — wants per-customer/per-route cost attribution in Console. Needs token-level breakdown, export CSV, and per-api-key RBAC. PCI scope concerns.

Ajay Malhotra: Thanks Maya. Can you paste the customer's story + priority? Do they need real-time or daily aggregates?

Maya (Support): Copied from ticket: "We need to show engineers and product owners exact token and time cost per request, grouped by org/project and endpoint. Exportable, filtered by date, and ability to drill into individual flows. Needed for billing reconciliation and internal chargebacks." They asked for daily first; realtime nice-to-have. Target: Q2 bill run.

Carmen Li: high-level constraints — realtime per-request attribution will be expensive. Proposal: precompute daily and per-hour aggregates + on-demand drilldowns with sampling. Can we narrow fields? token_count, model, route, latency, cost_usd, api_key_id

Sophia Patel: acceptance criteria suggestion:
- Per-route + per-api-key aggregated cost view (day/week/month)
- CSV export for selected date range
- Drilldown to request-level rows (sampled to 1000 rows by default) with link to logs
- RBAC: view vs export roles
- Perf: dashboard load <2s for 30d range

Carmen Li: sample API response (pseudo):
```
[{
  "date": "2026-04-01",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "redwood-neo-1",
  "tokens": 12345,
  "cost_usd": 12.34,
  "api_key_id": "k_abc123"
}]
```

Ajay Malhotra: Jira created: RED-1054 (observability: cost attribution). @Carmen can you own a 3-day spike to validate storage+query cost + sample UX mocks? @Sophia can you add telemetry events needed? @Maya please confirm customer's SLA and whether they require PCI scope expansion.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RED-1054 and linked support ticket SUP-9821 :ticket: 

Maya (Support): Confirmed — customer currently on enterprise contract; they want monthly data exports for billing reconciliation starting May. PCI scope: they asked whether logs contain PII — we said we'll redact API payloads by default and include token-level metadata only. They'll follow up.

Carmen Li: OK I'll run spike and share numbers. If storage/query cost > 15% of expected revenue, we'll propose sampling and add an enterprise opt-in. Suggest rollout: canary to dedicated customers first, then hosted.

Sophia Patel: UX notes: add per-route filter, group-by dropdown (date, model, api_key, org), and cost tooltip that shows token split (prompt vs completion). I'll mock in Figma and link here tomorrow.

Ajay Malhotra: Prioritization: P2 for Q2 backlog. Launch criteria: all acceptance criteria met + privacy review + docs + export endpoint. If spike shows high cost, downgrade realtime requirement.

Maya (Support): Customer meeting arranged for 2026-04-10 to walk through mockups. :calendar: 

Carmen Li: /remind me in 2 weeks to post spike results. :memo: 

Ajay Malhotra: Thanks team. Moving this to product intake board with tag "customer_request:acme-financial".
